meta.note: v2: Ponytail's structure and voice kept; palette re-cut to a navy-and-white Starry Night, display face Macaron, mobile-first with a bottom-right thumb dock.

tokens.name: fondo
tokens.usage: The sky: page ground behind every Pantalla, carrying the cielo star texture.

tokens.name: superficie
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and the Pantalla header.

tokens.name: superficie-alta
tokens.usage: Card header strip, pressed rows, inputs.

tokens.name: linea
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and the empty track of BarraAbono. Not a control border.

tokens.name: linea-fuerte
tokens.usage: Borders of quiet buttons and inputs; 3:1 on superficie in both themes.

tokens.name: tinta
tokens.usage: Primary text and amounts on fondo, superficie and superficie-alta.

tokens.name: tinta-suave
tokens.usage: Secondary text: dates, folios, hints, on fondo, superficie and superficie-alta.

tokens.name: estrella
tokens.usage: The brand's one strong mark: primary button fill, ceja, focus ring. White star on the night; deep navy by day.

tokens.name: sobre-estrella
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an estrella fill.

tokens.name: estrella-tenue
tokens.usage: Ground behind estrella text: selected row, active filter.

tokens.name: remolino
tokens.usage: The swirl blue: BarraAbono fill, links, trip facts (dates, hotel) and the Al corriente status. As text on superficie in both themes.

tokens.name: remolino-tenue
tokens.usage: Ground behind remolino text and the Al corriente chip.

tokens.name: cobalto
tokens.usage: Large brand fields only (cover, empty-state art). Not for text.

tokens.name: cielo-estrellas
tokens.usage: The star dots of the cielo texture on fondo. Decorative.

tokens.name: cielo-remolino
tokens.usage: The swirl rings of the cielo texture on fondo. Decorative.

tokens.name: pagado
tokens.usage: Status: fully paid. Always with the word 'Pagado'. Sea-green, kept cool to sit in the navy palette.

tokens.name: pagado-tenue
tokens.usage: Ground of the Pagado chip.

tokens.name: pendiente
tokens.usage: Status: an abono is due within 7 days. Always with the word. The pale yellow of Van Gogh's stars — the only warm note, used only for this.

tokens.name: pendiente-tenue
tokens.usage: Ground of the Pendiente chip.

tokens.name: vencido
tokens.usage: Status: past the fecha límite. Always with the word 'Vencido' and the days late.

tokens.name: vencido-tenue
tokens.usage: Ground of the Vencido chip.

tokens.name: neutro
tokens.usage: Status 'Sin abonos'.

tokens.name: neutro-tenue
tokens.usage: Ground of the Sin abonos chip.

styles.name: titular
styles.usage: One per Pantalla, in the header: the money that matters on this screen.

styles.name: ceja
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow above the titular, led by ✦, in estrella. One per Pantalla.

styles.name: boton
styles.usage: Button labels, sentence case, verb first.

styles.name: monto-grande
styles.usage: Totals and the saldo. Tabular figures; never in the display face.

styles.name: monto
styles.usage: Amounts in cards and rows. Tabular figures.

styles.name: cuerpo
styles.sample: Tu segundo abono vence el 15 de octubre.
styles.usage: Running text and inputs. 16px minimum so phones don't zoom on focus.

styles.name: nota
styles.usage: Metadata under a name or amount, in tinta-suave.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding; gap inside a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked lines and between dock buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone side gutter; card padding; the dock's inset from the right and bottom edges (plus the safe-area inset).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; header padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-dock
tokens.usage: Bottom padding of Pantalla content so the last card scrolls clear of the thumb dock.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Status chips, the MXN tag, BarraAbono.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs and quiet buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the Pantalla header's bottom corners.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Dock buttons (pills) and the primary thumb button.

tokens.name: anillo-foco
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px gap, then a solid 2px ring.

tokens.name: sombra-dock
tokens.usage: Only on the thumb dock's buttons, which float over scrolling content. Nothing else casts a shadow.

tamano.note: Mobile-first: design at 390 × 844 (iPhone 14/15), check at 360 wide.

tokens.name: pantalla-ancho
tokens.usage: Reference phone width; layouts are one column up to 480px.

tokens.name: pantalla-alto
tokens.usage: Reference phone height.

tokens.name: toque-min
tokens.usage: Smallest tap target anywhere: buttons, chips that act, list rows.

tokens.name: pulgar-principal
tokens.usage: Height of the primary dock button, bottom-right.
